text:
You need someone to turn your hospitality reservation idea into a clear, well-designed app concept that makes live table booking feel simple for both diners and restaurants.

Hi David — I’d be glad to help with that.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I have 7 years of experience building full-stack web products with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While your need is specifically for design and product clarity rather than development, I can absolutely help translate your idea into a practical app structure that a programming team can build from with confidence.

What I’d focus on for your reservation app is turning the concept into a clean user flow: how users discover restaurants, see live table availability, book instantly, and get confirmation without friction. I’d also think through the restaurant side of the experience so the product feels useful for both customers and venues, not just visually appealing. For a project like this, the design needs to make “live” availability feel trustworthy, fast, and easy to understand.

A project that’s relevant here is my Live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight. I built a dispatcher map that showed every truck’s position and ETA, with GPS updates pushed to the browser as they arrived. The result was 1,800 trucks tracked live and updates getting from ping to screen in under 2 seconds. That project taught me how to design around real-time information so users can act quickly without confusion — a useful mindset for live restaurant reservations as well.

If you want, I can help you shape the app into:
- a clear user journey for diners,
- a restaurant management flow,
- wireframe-level screen structure,
- and a design direction your programming team can implement.

I haven’t built a hospitality reservation app specifically, but I have worked on real-time, user-facing systems where clarity and speed were essential. If you’d like, I can help you turn your idea into something structured and build-ready.
